fields.description:
This week's conversation guide:
Las Fronteras y la Libertad de Movimiento: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VGEgz89WJujUGf0J5wtPXmBkqDZ3QePvMUIMQLWH-ks/edit

About the event:

A free Spanish conversation club for socialists. Everyone's welcome, and our big hope is that practicing here helps people organize in Spanish-speaking communities.

This isn't a Spanish class, so even in the beginner group, it helps everyone if you have the basics down: introducing yourself, what you do for fun, where you live.

We split into three levels, beginner, intermediate and advanced, and you pick yours. Not sure which level you're at? Each week's conversation guide is broken out by level, so looking it over is a great way to find out.

Keep practicing between sessions on our Discord, which also has resources if you're just starting out: https://discord.gg/HuefQSfHVm

Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spanishclubforsocialists/

¡Nos vemos!
